column1: # MaveScape count table: one row per variant and one column per sequenced sample.
# Variant names in MAVE-HGVS against your target: p.Ala12Val (protein) or c.34C>T (coding DNA).
# The wild type is p.= (or c.=); a synonymous variant is p.Ala12=; a stop is p.Ala12Ter.
# Counts are whole numbers of reads. Leave a cell empty or write NA when a sample did not count
# a variant: missing is never read as 0. Write 0 only when the variant was counted zero times.
# Name samples so their role shows: input or output (or pre and post); rep1 and rep2 for
# biological replicates; t0 t1 t2 for times; bin1 bin2 for sorted bins. MaveScape suggests
# roles from such names; you confirm them in the Experiment view.
# The example rows name residues of the example target (target.fasta): S2 and K3.
# Lines starting with # are skipped. Delete them and these example rows; keep the header.
